assessment.title: Management Assessment on ICOFR Implementation Effectiveness
assessment.subtitle: Appendix 11 - SK-5/DKU.MBU/11/2024
assessment.effectiveDesc: Based on the evaluation performed, management concludes that the Company has maintained, in all material respects, effective internal control over financial reporting as of the report date.
assessment.ineffectiveDesc: Based on the evaluation performed, management concludes that the Company did not maintain effective internal control over financial reporting as of the report date, due to identified material weaknesses.
assessment.directorsStatement: The Board of Directors of {{companyName}} states that:
assessment.statement1: We have reviewed the financial statements of {{companyName}} ending on {{date}}.
assessment.statement2: To our knowledge, the financial statements do not contain any untrue statement of a material fact or omit to state a material fact necessary to make the statements made, in light of the circumstances under which such statements were made, not misleading.
assessment.statement3: To our knowledge, the financial statements and other financial information included in the financial statements, fairly present in all material respects the financial condition and results of operations for the period presented.
assessment.statement4: We have implemented controls and procedures for the preparation of financial statements deemed necessary to properly prepare and present the financial statements (consolidated) and free from material misstatement.
assessment.noDeficiencies: No significant deficiencies or material weaknesses found.

c.title: C — Completeness
c.desc: Ensures all transactions, assets, liabilities, and equity interests that should have been recorded have been fully recorded without omission.

a.title: A — Accuracy
a.desc: Ensures amounts, computations, and other data relating to recorded transactions and events have been recorded and calculated appropriately.

eo.title: E/O — Existence / Occurrence
eo.desc: Ensures assets, liabilities, and equity interests exist at the reporting date, and recorded transactions actually occurred during the period.

co.title: CO — Cut-Off
co.desc: Ensures all transactions and events have been recorded in the correct accounting period and fiscal year.

ro.title: R&O — Rights & Obligations
ro.desc: Ensures the entity holds or controls the rights to assets, and liabilities are legitimate obligations of the entity.

va.title: V/A — Valuation & Allocation
va.desc: Ensures assets, liabilities, and equity interests are included at appropriate amounts and resulting valuation adjustments are properly allocated.

pd.title: PD — Presentation & Disclosure
pd.desc: Ensures financial components are appropriately aggregated or disaggregated, clearly described, and relevant disclosures meet reporting standards.

box1.title: Box 1: Direct Financial Statement Assertion
box1.desc: Evaluates whether the control deficiency directly correlates with financial statement assertions (C, A, E/O, CO, R&O, V/A, PD).

box2.title: Box 2: Misstatement Likelihood
box2.desc: Evaluates whether there is a reasonable possibility that controls will fail to prevent or detect misstatements on a timely basis.

box3.title: Box 3: Potential Magnitude vs Performance Materiality
box3.desc: Evaluates whether the potential misstatement exposure equals or exceeds the established Performance Materiality (PM) threshold.

box4.title: Box 4: Governance Attention
box4.desc: Evaluates whether the deficiency is sufficiently important to merit formal attention by those responsible for oversight (Board & Audit Committee).

box5.title: Box 5: Compensating Controls
box5.desc: Evaluates whether effective secondary or compensating controls operate at sufficient precision to mitigate potential material misstatements.

box6.title: Box 6: Prudent Official Consideration
box6.desc: Evaluates whether a competent, knowledgeable, and objective prudent official would conclude the deficiency represents a Material Weakness.

box7.title: Box 7: Combinatorial / Aggregate Impact
box7.desc: Evaluates whether combinations of multiple deficiencies impacting the same account or assertion collectively elevate to a Significant Deficiency / Material Weakness.
